name: Дерево и ткань
style: TIMBER / CLOTH: muted gray-brown wooden plaques, flat broad faces and simple dark edge, small coarse red or indigo fabric wraps ONLY around the short ends. Wood remains visible across the whole lettering area. Active tab has a short hanging muted red cloth marker; inactive end wraps indigo. Panel corners secured by modest stitched fabric patches; primary CTA brick-stained wood. Dry textile, low contrast, no gold hardware.
prompt: Create ONE complete fully illustrated 16:9 hub screen for intoDeDung. Use the reference for layout, fortress, labels and exactly three squad cards. Keep four top tabs, resource line, squad left, open fortress courtyard center, preparation right and main button bottom-right. Stone fortress, tents, plain red/blue flags, warm sunset; exactly three small courtyard heroes. Focus on BUTTONS AND FRAMES: every tab and action has visible MATTE WOOD as its entire face, subdued grain and diffuse shading. No lacquer, gloss, shiny metal, gold edges, glow, jewels or specular streaks. Warm cream labels on dark wood, dark ink on pale wood. Selected tab and selected hero use a quiet painted brick/ochre line plus a small marker; absolutely no bright yellow/gold card outline. Primary CTA is more prominent through silhouette and muted red-brown wood, not shine. Panel interiors calm parchment. Information rows must stay flat text, not raised buttons. Do not duplicate cards or add UI. Exact labels: 'Поход', 'Наёмники', 'Кузнец', 'Колода'; 'Отряд', 'Воин', 'Щитоносец', 'Лучница', 'Дополнительно'; 'Подготовка', '7 комнат', 'Отряд: 3', 'Колода: 10 карт', 'Готово', 'В путь'; 'Золото 100', 'Эссенция 0'. Simple readable icons. Full finished screen, no collage, no outside captions, no watermark. VARIANT: TIMBER / CLOTH: muted gray-brown wooden plaques, flat broad faces and simple dark edge, small coarse red or indigo fabric wraps ONLY around the short ends. Wood remains visible across the whole lettering area. Active tab has a short hanging muted red cloth marker; inactive end wraps indigo. Panel corners secured by modest stitched fabric patches; primary CTA brick-stained wood. Dry textile, low contrast, no gold hardware.
